post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I was overconfident in my initial leadership, taking on missions that seemed too ambitious and resulted in failure. I also struggled to effectively use my actions to help my allies in times of need. Improving my decision-making and action management will be key areas of focus for future games.

player_observations.Bob: Bob played well as a good hero, contributing to the team effort and supporting his allies when needed. However, his failure to provide leadership and strategic vision was a missed opportunity to take charge.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie performed well as the assassin, effectively manipulating the narrative to achieve their dark goals. Their ability to adapt and play according to plan was impressive, despite being a relatively inexperienced player in the game.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's role as Merlin was well-executed, providing valuable information and insight to the team and helping to sway the outcome of key missions. Her strategic thinking and communication were instrumental in keeping the team informed and on track.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played a masterful game as the evil leader, utilizing her actions and influence to maximize her benefits and exploit her opponents' weaknesses. She demonstrated exceptional cunning and adaptability throughout the game.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I tried my best to complete missions but was unsuccessful due to failing one card in each mission. I should have been more cautious and paid closer attention to suspicious behavior. In retrospect, I think I was too trusting and gave away my innocence too easily.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was a solid team player and contributed to every mission, making sure we had the necessary roles to complete the mission objectives. Her play was consistent and reliable.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's actions were subtle but effective. He managed to infiltrate two of our missions without raising suspicion, which really hurt us. I should have seen through his innocent behavior earlier.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was instrumental in providing essential information to our team, particularly in Mission 2. Her ability to reveal important cards helped us to strategize but unfortunately, it wasn't enough to save us.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was ruthless and strategic in her gameplay. She made calculated moves to take out our good roles and sabotage our chances of success, ultimately leading to our downfall.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully infiltrated the team and deceived everyone, including the Merlin, which proved critical to our victory. However, my early failures in missions gave the team a strong sense of trust, making it more challenging to execute the plan later on. I could improve by taking a more aggressive approach in the early stages.

player_observations.Eve: Eve played a crucial role as the leader in our initial mission, and her ability to inspire trust was impressive. However, she struggled to adapt to the changing dynamics of the team and ultimately relied on me to take care of business.
player_observations.Bob: Bob demonstrated excellent leadership skills, but his strong sense of morality made it challenging for him to suspect me. He also struggled with trusting others, which occasionally put us at risk.
player_observations.Alice: Alice's innocent nature made her a perfect target for my deception, but her inability to see through my facade also meant she couldn't provide the team with valuable insight when needed.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's subtle gameplay as Merlin was impressive, and she successfully manipulated the team's perceptions without arousing suspicion. However, her passivity at times made it difficult for her to effectively execute her role.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I was too cautious and waited for the perfect moment to expose the assassin, but ultimately it wasn't enough. I should have taken more risks and acted more proactively to uncover the traitor. Communication with teammates could have been better to avoid multiple fails in a row.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was a great leader and had a good instinct for what missions to attempt and when to call for a vote of no confidence. She often seemed to know who to trust and formed a strong bond with me.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was initially a bit reserved and didn't reveal his alignment as quickly as I expected, but once he felt comfortable, he became a strong advocate for the team and helped to sway some of the decisions.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie as the assassin masterfully played the game keeping a poker face the entire time, only occasionally making subtle moves that caught our attention. Once his identity was outed, we realized that he had been using his votes strategically to sabotage our plans.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was the perfect evil leader, using her knowledge of her team's dynamics to manipulate votes and decisions to her advantage. She didn't make any obvious moves and remained completely under the radar throughout the game.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I executed my evil role effectively by manipulating the game state to our team's advantage, while maintaining stealth and deception. My ability to correctly identify and eliminate Merlin was crucial to our victory. However, I could have been more proactive in the early missions to eliminate our opposition's chances of succeeding.

player_observations.Diana: I was impressed by Diana's ability to fly under the radar and provide support without revealing her identity as Merlin. Her careful decision-making helped our team in Mission 3, allowing us to eliminate one of the opposition's team members.
player_observations.Alice: Alice displayed a classic good player's naivety, always trusting others and underestimating the danger. Her inexperience in the game proved to be a vulnerability that we exploited to our advantage.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was a more aggressive good player, always trying to take risks and eliminate opposition players. While this approach led to some successes, it also resulted in his downfall in Mission 3, demonstrating a lack of strategic thinking.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's actions as the Assassin were effective, but their aggressive playstyle often put themselves at risk. I observed them trying to eliminate Alice in Mission 2, which could have backfired if not for the fact that they were part of our team.
